name: Carlo Doroff
introductionTranscript: Hi there, I'm Carlo Doroff, born and raised in Minnesota, but a junior at the University of Miami, where I'm studying finance, entrepreneurship, and AI. I have experience ranging from sales, finance, and investment banking wealth management, and also starting my own company. In sales, I've done door-to-door sales, where I generated $107,000, selling door-to-door in Winchester, Massachusetts. Pest control. Following that job, I went into investment banking, where I worked at Curvature Securities. We worked on micro-cap deals. After that, I started my own company, Craze, where we did Gen Z market research for companies like Celsius and Victoria's Secret subsidiaries. We had a student app across 198 campuses. And now, I'm leading go-to-market at a startup in San Francisco. If you're interested in tech, entrepreneurship, or would like to connect about anything at all, reach out. Thank you so much.
